name: Sales growth projection
meaning: Projects sales from a documented growth assumption.

variables.Model inputs: Forecast values defined using documented timing and balance conventions.

intuition: Projects sales from a documented growth assumption.
workedExample: Apply the relationship to a fictional company using explicit timing and balance conventions.
commonMistake: Treating a modeling convention as a universal identity or failing to link the resulting statements.
relatedLearningOutcome: demonstrate the development of a sales-based pro forma company model

name: Price-volume revenue projection

meaning: Separates nominal revenue into price and volume drivers.
